question: Which of the following states hosts the annual Surajkund crafts fair?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Haryana**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Surajkund International Crafts Mela (Faridabad)**

 
 
• Surajkund Mela is an annual crafts fair held in the state of **Haryana, India**.
 
• Celebrated from: **March 19 to April 4, 2022**.
 
• Key attractions: **Rich display of regional and international crafts and traditions.**
 
• The fair is organized by the **Surajkund Mela Authority and Haryana Tourism in association with the Union Ministry of Tourism, Textiles, Culture and External Affairs.**
 
• The Surajkund Mela is unique as it showcases the richness and diversity of India's handicrafts, handlooms and cultural fabrics, and is** the largest crafts fair in the world.**
